technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with stochastic bounce signal, but weak trend confirmation, negative money flow, and price below all short-term MAs limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: RTX shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, and earnings arriving in 84 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (18/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 small purchase vs 2 sales) and absent news sentiment provide weak confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (432.8), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinational industrials, FOMC event in 1 day adds binary risk, and earnings in 84 days creates additional uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 extreme oversold (below 30) with stochastic bullish crossover and EMA 50/200 bullish alignment create textbook mean-reversion setup near support at 84.79, amplified by extreme fear sentiment (18/100) offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis at 432.8, flat yield curve, rising DXY), price below all short-term MAs with negative money flow (CMF), weak trend confirmation (ADX), FOMC event in 1 day, and zero fundamental catalysts (no insider activity, high earnings risk in 84 days) make this a high-risk, low-conviction entry.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI extreme oversold with stochastic bullish cross offers mean-reversion appeal, but severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, FOMC in 1 day) and price below all short-term MAs create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event in 1 day combined with VIX crisis (432.8) and negative money flow create binary downside risk that overwhelms technical oversold bounce setup.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents see contrarian opportunity, but risk and fundamental agents correctly dominate with macro crisis concerns and zero catalysts
decision.portfolio_note: Already 4 positions in Industrials sector; adding RTX increases concentration risk during macro stress without fundamental conviction or smart money support.
